metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Hong Kong increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 OFFL dataset (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) for Hong Kong bounding box. If empty, fallback to NRTI (COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2). Date windows: 2020-02-10 to 2020-02-25 and 2020-04-20 to 2020-05-12.
2. Masking strategy: Apply qa_value >= 0.75 mask (standard quality filter for S5P). Not a cloud question; focus on valid pixels after QA.
3. Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Check image collection size first (C1 if 0 after fallback). After masking, compute valid pixel counts; if 0, C2. Compute region mean; if null/NaN, C3. Compare P2 > P1 -> A (Yes), else B (No).
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[113.75, 22.05], [114.62, 22.05], [114.62, 22.65], [113.75, 22.65], [113.75, 22.05]]
    ], null, false);

    const p1Start = '2020-02-10';
    const p1End = '2020-02-25';
    const p2Start = '2020-04-20';
    const p2End = '2020-05-12';

    const datasets = [
      'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2',
      'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2'
    ];

    // Helper to evaluate server-side objects
    const evalEE = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });

    async function getPeriodStats(start, end) {
      let usedDataset = null;
      let col = null;
      let sizeVal = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < datasets.length; i++) {
        const id = datasets[i];
        let tcol = ee.ImageCollection(id)
          .filterBounds(geom)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']);
        const s = await evalEE(tcol.size());
        if (s > 0) {
          usedDataset = id;
          col = tcol;
          sizeVal = s;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!col || sizeVal === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1' };
      }

      const maskedCol = col.map(function(img) {
        const qa = img.select('qa_value');
        const m = qa.gte(0.75);
        const no2 = img.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
                       .updateMask(m).rename('no2');
        return no2.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
      });

      const comp = maskedCol.mean();

      // Count valid pixels (after QA mask)
      const validCountDict = comp.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      const totalCountDict = ee.Image(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      const meanDict = comp.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      const validPx = await evalEE(validCountDict.get('no2'));
      const totalPx = await evalEE(totalCountDict.get('ones'));
      const meanVal = await evalEE(meanDict.get('no2'));

      if (!validPx || validPx === 0) {
        return {
          status: 'C2',
          dataset: usedDataset,
          images: sizeVal,
          validPx: validPx || 0,
          totalPx: totalPx || 0
        };
      }

      if (meanVal === null || meanVal === undefined || !isFinite(meanVal)) {
        return { status: 'C3' };
      }

      const validPct = totalPx ? (100.0 * validPx / totalPx) : 0.0;

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        dataset: usedDataset,
        images: sizeVal,
        validPx: validPx,
        totalPx: totalPx,
        validPct: validPct,
        mean: meanVal
      };
    }

    // 2. Compute stats for both periods
    const p1 = await getPeriodStats(p1Start, p1End);
    const p2 = await getPeriodStats(p2Start, p2End);

    // 3. Handle failure cases
    if (p1.status === 'C1' || p2.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (p1.status === 'C2' || p2.status === 'C2') {
      console.log('No valid pixels after QA for one or both periods.');
      if (p1.status === 'C2') {
        console.log(`P1 Valid px: ${p1.validPx}/${p1.totalPx}`);
      }
      if (p2.status === 'C2') {
        console.log(`P2 Valid px: ${p2.validPx}/${p2.totalPx}`);
      }
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (p1.status === 'C3' || p2.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('Calculation failure (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`P1 [${p1.dataset}] ${p1Start} to ${p1End} -> Images: ${p1.images}, Valid px: ${p1.validPx}/${p1.totalPx} (${p1.validPct.toFixed(1)}%), Mean NO2: ${p1.mean.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);
    console.log(`P2 [${p2.dataset}] ${p2Start} to ${p2End} -> Images: ${p2.images}, Valid px: ${p2.validPx}/${p2.totalPx} (${p2.validPct.toFixed(1)}%), Mean NO2: ${p2.mean.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);

    const diff = p2.mean - p1.mean;
    const ratio = p1.mean !== 0 ? (p2.mean / p1.mean) : null;
    console.log(`Δ (P2 - P1): ${diff.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);
    if (ratio !== null && isFinite(ratio)) {
      console.log(`Ratio (P2/P1): ${ratio.toFixed(3)}`);
    }

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(diff)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
